s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of neurological deficits with tumefactive brain lesion
salient_findings: Subacute onset of expressive aphasia and right-sided hemiparesis
Large T2-hyperintense, tumefactive lesion in the left prefrontal white matter
key_facts: 23-year history of presumed multiple sclerosis
Four episodes of optic neuritis since 1989
Longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis in 1995
Persistently negative cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) oligoclonal bands
Unremarkable brain MRI scans prior to 2012
Monthly intravenous methylprednisolone pulses and interferon-β treatment
Normal complete blood count and metabolic panel
Normal vital signs
Brain MRI showing T2-hyperintense lesions without clear evidence of a disturbed blood–brain barrier
Unchanged choline peak on MR spectroscopy
Unremarkable CSF analysis with no oligoclonal bands and normal cell count
No signs of vasculitis on time-of-flight MR angiography
No clinical or serological evidence for connective tissue diseases

shortlist.label: Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder
shortlist.why_kept: Serum aquaporin-4 antibody titre was 1:1000 by cell-based assay, consistent with neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder

shortlist.label: Tumefactive multiple sclerosis
shortlist.why_kept: History of presumed multiple sclerosis and presence of tumefactive brain lesion

shortlist.label: Multiple sclerosis
shortlist.why_kept: 23-year history of presumed multiple sclerosis with episodes of optic neuritis and transverse myelitis

shortlist.label: Acute disseminated encephalomyelitis
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute onset of neurological deficits with tumefactive brain lesion, although less likely given the patient's age and history

shortlist.label: Balo's concentric sclerosis
shortlist.why_kept: Tumefactive brain lesion with a history of presumed multiple sclerosis, and Balo's concentric sclerosis is a rare variant of multiple sclerosis

raw.rationale: The patient's history of longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis and optic neuritis, along with the presence of aquaporin-4 antibody, strongly supports this diagnosis

rejected.label: Tumefactive multiple sclerosis
rejected.why: Lack of oligoclonal bands in CSF and presence of aquaporin-4 antibody are not typical for tumefactive MS

rejected.label: Multiple sclerosis
rejected.why: Persistently negative CSF oligoclonal bands and presence of aquaporin-4 antibody are atypical for MS

rejected.label: Acute disseminated encephalomyelitis
rejected.why: The patient's history of relapsing episodes over 23 years does not fit with the typical monophasic course of ADEM

rejected.label: Balo's concentric sclerosis
rejected.why: The patient's MRI findings do not show the characteristic concentric rings of demyelination
